content.title: Implement /status endpoint and E2E environment guard
content.description:
Implement:

Part A — endpoint:
- Create server/routes/status.ts: GET / returns { agentrackPath: <cwd> } using the shared cwd resolution.
- Register app.route('/api/status', statusRoute) in server/index.ts.
- Add StatusResponse to server/types.ts.

Part B — guard:
- In e2e/global-setup.ts (or setup.ts), after webServers are up, fetch the /api/status endpoint on the E2E API port (5001). If agentrackPath equals <projectRoot>/.agentrack, throw to abort the test run before any test runs. Otherwise proceed.
- Implement the ordering/fetch-failure fallback defined in the plan.

First implement the endpoint, then the guard (the guard depends on the endpoint existing).

content.reason: Blocker issue mqh2hwl22k transitioned to done

content.content:
Done. Implemented the /status endpoint and the E2E environment guard per the plan in mqh2hwl22k.

**Part A — endpoint (server)**
- New `server/routes/status.ts`: `GET /` returns `{ agentrackPath: <cwd> }` reusing the shared `cwd` export from `server/utils/tracker.ts` so the endpoint and the Tracker singleton can never drift.
- Registered `app.route("/api/status", statusRoute)` in `server/index.ts` as a sibling top-level route (issues/comments/blockages routes untouched).
- Added `StatusResponse` to `server/types.ts`.
- Per Decision 1 of the plan, removed `cwd` from `HealthResponse` and from `server/routes/health.ts` (and its stale isolation-guard comment). `/health` is now a pure liveness probe; `/status` is the authoritative isolation endpoint. The frontend `HealthResponse` already matched this shape, and phase1's health-shape e2e test only asserts `status` + `tracker`, so no regressions.

**Part B — guard (e2e/global-setup.ts)**
- Kept `waitForBackend()` polling `/api/health`.
- After the readiness gate, fetches `/api/status` and asserts `body.agentrackPath === getE2EDataDir()` (allowlist-of-one — strictly stronger than the spec's 'abort if equals real .agentrack/' form, as recommended in the plan).
- Fetch-failure fallback: if the `/api/status` fetch throws after the server was confirmed healthy, abort with 'isolation unverified'. If it returns non-2xx, abort (catches stale dev servers without the `/status` route). Both throw before any seed is created.
- Fixed the pre-existing string-interpolation bug: the mismatch throw now uses a backtick template literal so `` actually interpolates.
- Added `E2E_BACKEND_PORT: "5001"` to the backend webServer env in `playwright.config.ts` so the guard's port and the webServer port share a single source of truth (no magic-number drift).

**Verification**
- Frontend build (tsc -b + vite) passes — clean.
- Manually hit both endpoints with AGENTRACK_CWD set: `/api/status` returned the e2e path; `/api/health` returned `{ status, tracker }` with no `cwd`.
- Hit `/api/status` with AGENTRACK_CWD unset: returned the repo root, i.e. the guard would throw and abort — the failure path the validator (mqh2hwfsqg) exercises works as intended.

**Caveat for the validator**
- I could NOT run the full `npx playwright test` suite on this machine: port 5000 is held by the macOS AirPlay Receiver, so the frontend webServer fails to bind. Backend-only verification (above) works. The validator should plan around the 5000/5001 bind (called out in the plan's GOTCHAS). Note also the known-gap pre-existing phase1–3 failures (mqdzlo4ia8) — those are unrelated to this change.

No lint script exists for the webapp; the frontend build is the project's typecheck/lint gate (per the webapp expertise notes).
